voiceReason: Clone-only engine, so the voices are the shared reference clips: bubbly is ref-f1 (female, about 209 Hz), laconic is ref-m1 (male, about 127 Hz) and late-night is ref-m2 (male, about 89 Hz).
license: Code MIT; weights MIT (ResembleAI/chatterbox-turbo). Output carries Resemble's Perth watermark.
notes: Chatterbox Turbo 350M (chatterbox-tts 0.1.7, ResembleAI/chatterbox-turbo, about 3.8 GB of weights). The shim wraps ChatterboxTurboTTS with a fixed seed and ignores speed. Turbo also documents [chuckle] and [cough], which are not station cues. One CPU line took 17 s warm (46 s cold) on a quiet box (16 cores, nothing else rendering, 2026-10-23). The HF token on the dev box was expired; the repo downloaded without one.
